text: 在全球债券收益率上升、国内政治僵局持续的背景下，法国公共财政正受到越来越严格的审视。法国财政部长Lescure表示，随着全球经济走弱、利率上升，2027年财政预算案将需要采取大规模节支措施，以控制不断扩大的财政赤字。Lescure表示，如果月底将提交的预算案不采取任何措施，赤字可能扩大至相当于国内生产总值约6%的水平，而政府希望将其控制在5%以下。
text_en: Amid rising global bond yields and prolonged domestic political gridlock, France's public finances are under increasing scrutiny. French Finance Minister Lescure said that with a weakening global economy and higher interest rates, the 2027 budget will require large-scale spending cuts to control the widening fiscal deficit. Lescure said that without measures in the budget to be submitted at the end of the month, the deficit could widen to around 6% of GDP, while the government aims to keep it below 5%.
